blurb: Guests participate in hot yoga classes in a heated room at 105°F following the Original 90-minute 26&2 Bikram Yoga method. The studio offers over 35 classes per week at two locations, Waikiki and Ewa Beach. Classes require reservations and memberships or class packages must be purchased prior to attendance.
